name: Tenir
description: Self-hosted live captions for the Even Realities G2. Streams mic PCM to your own Tenir server over WebSocket and renders live captions on the lens, with a phone page for sign-in, the live transcript, and conversation history.

permissions.description: Streams microphone audio to your self-hosted Tenir server for live captioning

hardwareRequirements.description: Shows live captions on glasses with a display; the phone page works without one
Captures the speech that is captioned
